Class PlaybackTrackingService

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.service.PlaybackTrackingService
@Service public class PlaybackTrackingService extends Object
Records listening history rows and later completes them with the played duration.

A play is recorded once, when the browser reports 20 seconds of actual playback (recordPlay(Song)). The id of the freshly saved PlaybackHistory row is remembered so that a later skip or natural song end can fill in the real duration through updateCurrentPlayDuration(Integer, boolean).

The web app is a singleton shared by many users, so the "current playback row" is kept per user id in a ConcurrentHashMap instead of a single field. One user skipping a song can therefore never complete another user's row.

SRP: owns persistence of playback history rows and nothing about queues or audio.

Time Complexity: O(1) for all operations except getRecentlyPlayed(Long).

Space Complexity: O(u) where u = number of users with an open playback row.

  • Method Details

    • recordPlay

      public void recordPlay(Song song)
      Creates the playback history row for the current user and increments the song's listen count.

      The id of the saved row is stored for the current user so that updateCurrentPlayDuration(Integer, boolean) can find it later.

      Time Complexity: O(1). Three database operations.

      Space Complexity: O(1)

      Parameters:
      song - the song that has been listened to for at least 20 seconds
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no user is logged in or the user no longer exists

    • getRecentlyPlayed

      public List<PlaybackHistory> getRecentlyPlayed(Long userId)
      Returns the most recent playback history rows of a user, songs fetched.

      Time Complexity: O(n) where n = number of rows returned (at most 50).

      Space Complexity: O(n)

      Parameters:
      userId - the user whose history is wanted
      Returns:
      up to 50 history rows, newest first; empty when there are none

    • updateCurrentPlayDuration

      public void updateCurrentPlayDuration(Integer durationPlayedSeconds, boolean completed)
      Completes the current user's open playback row with the seconds actually played.

      Does nothing when the user has no open row (the song never reached 20 seconds). The open row is forgotten afterwards so it can be completed only once.

      Parameters:
      durationPlayedSeconds - seconds of the song that were played
      completed - true when the song played to its natural end
